source.author: verg
source.text: Hi summo in fluctu pendent; his unda dehiscens terram inter fluctus aperit; furit aestus harenis.
source.text_original: Hi summo in fluctu pendent; his unda dehiscens / terram inter fluctus aperit; furit aestus harenis.
source.text_english: These hang on the crest of the wave; for them the yawning billow opens a gap between the waves and the land; the tide rages with the sands.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: qui tum Minyis trepidantibus horror, cum picei fulsere poli pavidamque coruscae ante ratem cecidere faces, antemnaque laevo prona dehiscentem cornu cum sustulit undam.
reuse.text_original: qui tum Minyis trepidantibus horror, / cum picei fulsere poli pavidamque coruscae / ante ratem cecidere faces, antemnaque laevo / prona dehiscentem cornu cum sustulit undam.
reuse.text_english: Then there was dread among the Minyae, when the pitch-dark heavens flashed and the blazing brands fell before the terrified ship, and the leaning yardarm lifted the wave breaking open on the left side.
